Bunny Derby Rules & Types

Bunny Derby is a special Derby mode where in addition to the normal Derby competition, your neighborhood can catch up to 3 Bunnies during the week to unlock extra rewards.

It can run in combination with other Derby types (Power, Mystery, Chill) Derby Types

Catching Bunnies is optional - the normal Derby scoring and leaderboard still matter. If you're pushing for top placement rather than receiving the most prizes, going full speed is better than waiting for Bunny Time

Bunny Tasks & Bunny Time:

1. First Bunny Appearance

- The very first task you take will not be a Bunny Task. After that task is taken, the game will trigger Bunny appearances.

2. Bunny Time Windows

- When a Bunny is available (on the racetrack), Bunny Time will occur periodically. Bunny Time lasts 10 minutes.

- During Bunny Time, tasks turn pink and display a bunny icon. This marks them as Bunny Tasks. *You do not have to finish these tasks during Bunny Time*- as long as the task was taken during the 10 minute window, completing it after Bunny Time is over will still count towards catching the Bunny (as long as the Bunny has not already been caught by other players).

3. Catching the Bunny

- Each Bunny requires a certain number of Bunny Tasks to catch it. That number depends on how many players have opted into the Derby, and your neighborhoods League (Rookie, Novice, Professional, Expert, Champions). Neighborhood

- Once the Bunny has been "caught", your Hood (neighborhood) unlocks that Bunny's extra reward (added column). - After catching one Bunny, a delay will occur in Bunny Time until the next Bunny arrives. *Tasks taken and completed prior to a new Bunny arriving will not count towards the upcoming Bunny.*

4. Number and Timing of Bunnies

- There are 3 Bunnies total in a Bunny Derby.

The schedule is roughly as follows:

- Bunny #1 appears around Tuesday 12:34 UTC

- Bunny #2 appears around Wednesday 18:48 UTC

- Bunny #3 appears around Friday 17:50 UTC

If your neighborhood has not taken its first task before Tuesday 12:34 UTC, then the bunny will appear on the track close to 10 seconds after any player takes the first task to start the derby.

Note that the in-game timer always overstates the time to the initial appearance of each of these bunnies by 100 minutes (1h40m), which coincidentally is the total time of one bunny time (10 minutes) and one cooldown period (90 minutes). This bug has existed for years and doesn't appear to be on the list of things to be fixed. If your neighborhood has not taken its first bunny task before Tuesday 12:34 UTC, then the bunny will appear on the track close to 10 seconds after any player takes the first task to start the derby.

Each time your Hood "catches" a Bunny, an extra reward column unlocks. These are earned in addition to the regular Derby rewards.

Power Bunny Derby

Overview

The Power Bunny Derby combines the high-energy pace of a Power Derby Derby Types with the playful rewards of the Bunny Derby. Derby Types

Neighborhoods race for points and chase bunnies for bonus prizes! Each Bunny caught unlocks a new reward column at the end of the Derby.

How it Works

- Players complete tasks to earn points and move their horses around the Derby track.

- During Bunny Time windows, tasks will appear with a pink Bunny icon- these are Bunny Tasks.

- You still get the 3 Bunnies to catch over the Derby period, unlocking extra rewards if your neighborhood completes the required Bunny tasks.

Power Derby Rules

Because this is a Power Derby Power Derby Tasks, each player can take on more tasks than usual depending on their groups league Neighborhood:

Max Total Points per Player (free):

Rookie- 10 tasks - 3200/player Novice- 12 tasks - 3840/player Professional- 14 tasks - 4480/player Expert- 16 tasks - 5120/player Champions- 18 tasks - 5760/player

Rewards

Each Bunny caught unlocks an extra reward column at the end of the Derby.

Because you have more tasks overall, it is easier to reserve enough tasks to commit to capturing each bunny. The number of tasks required to capture a bunny is the same as in normal bunny derby (it does not increase, even with the doubled task allotment).

Possible rewards include: Decorations/Rewards

- Puzzle Pieces Puzzle Piece - Expansion Permits Expansion Permit - Vouchers Voucher - Boosters Boosters - Decorations Decorations - Mining Supplies Mine

(Regular Derby rewards [horseshoes] are still earned based on total points).

Strategy Tips

- Start one easy task right away to trigger the first Bunny appearence.

- Save a few easy or high-value tasks for Bunny Time to maximize Bunny catches (let your Hood know you're saving it).

- Communicate with your neighborhood - teamwork is key!:

- Ask if your Hood will be prioritizing Bunnies or Placement, since chasing bunnies can slow your total Derby progress.

- Always check the Bunny Time countdowns so you don't miss the window.

Chill Bunny Derby

Overview

The Chill Bunny Derby is all about relaxed pacing. There is no competition between neighborhoods - just you and your Hood doing easy tasks, catching bunnies, and earning rewards stress-free. This version mixes Chill Bunny Derby and Bunny Derby mechanics. Derby Types

How it Works

- Every day, each player gets up to 5 tasks from the Derby board. Derby Tasks

- Each player can also buy 1 extra task per day with 2 diamonds.

- Tasks must be used within that days quota - the unused tasks do not carry over to the next.

- Bunny mechanics (Bunny Time, Bunny Tasks, catching Bunnies) function similar to standard Bunny Derby rules.

Chill Derby Rules

- Bunny Time windows are 10 minutes - 90 minute pauses apply.

Because you are limited by the daily task quota, timing your tasks around Bunny Time is extra critical.

Max Total Points per Player:

Tasks per day - 5 (+1 extra purchasable)

Total Tasks (if all days used) - 35 free (up to 42 with daily extra task purchase)

Max Total Points per Player - 1,750 - 2,100 points

Rewards

- Catching each Bunny unlocks an extra reward column, just like in the other Bunny Derbies.

- Chill Derby reward columns use a different prize pool, and typically do not include decorations. Decorations/Rewards

- Since there is no promotion/demotion or competition, your focus will be on Bunny rewards and relaxed play.

Strategy Tips

- Don't waste your daily tasks - plan ahead for Bunny Times so your task quota for the day isn't used up before a Bunny appears.

- Because tasks do not carry over to the following quota, you may want to reserve some tasks for Bunny windows.

- Use simpler/quicker tasks (help, mining, truck, etc.) Derby Tasks during non-Bunny periods.

- Communicate with your Hood so that everyone can aim tasks around Bunny Time.

Mystery Bunny Derby

Overview

The Mystery Bunny Derby mixes the mystery "?" tasks of a Mystery Derby with Bunny Derby mechanics. Derby Types You will see special, unknown tasks (covered with a purple question mark) on your task board, along with some "regular" derby tasks that are unhidden. Derby Tasks

How it Works

- On the Derby Task Board, you will see mystery tasks (tasks that you cannot fully see until you select them) mixed in with regular tasks.

- Mystery Tasks have a higher point value than regular tasks (400 points).

- There is a maximum of 4 mystery tasks available on the board at a time.

- You can trash non-mystery tasks to let more mystery tasks pop up. (Although trashing tasks will reduce your Hoods Champions League leaderboard score). Neighborhood Management

- Bunny mechanics (Bunny Time, Bunny Tasks, etc.) overlay on top of the mystery rules. So during Bunny Time, tasks may carry the Bunny tag even if they are mystery tasks.

Mystery Derby Rules

Rookie- 10 tasks - 3200/player Novice- 12 tasks - 3840/player Professional- 14 tasks - 4480/player Expert- 16 tasks - 5120/player Champions- 18 tasks - 5760/player

(This may vary depending on how many mystery tasks become available and completed.)

Rewards

- You still unlock extra Bunny reward columns if your neighborhood catches the Bunnies.

- In addition, Mystery Derby itself offers its own reward structure via the Mystery tasks (higher point values).

- Your total prize haul is a combination of Mystery Derby rewards and Bunny bonuses.

Strategy Tips

- If you see a mystery task pop up during Bunny Time, claim it fast - that is prime Bunny Task territory.

- Try to plan for your resource production (machines, fields, animals, etc.) to match the time when you will be able to pick tasks - so that you are not holding up a mystery task due to missing product.

- Because you cannot do not know what the mystery task will be ahead of time, flexibility is key.
